message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occur in Canada during 2023.  
These are the statutory holidays that either fall on a Friday or Monday (or are observed on a Monday when they fall on a weekend), thereby creating a three‑day weekend.  (Note that some holidays are province‑specific; the list above reflects the national holidays that apply across the country.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|--------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Dec 31 – Jan 2 (2022‑2023) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Monday | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | May 20 – May 22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Jul 1 – Jul 3 (observed Jul 3) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | Nov 11 – Nov 13 (observed Nov 13) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Dec 23 – Dec 25 |

**Quick notes**

- **New Year’s Day** falls on a Sunday, so the holiday is observed on the following Monday (Jan 2).  
- **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday, so the holiday is observed on the following Monday (Jul 3).  
- **Remembrance Day** falls on a Saturday, so the holiday is observed on the following Monday (Nov 13).  

If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), let me know and I can add those as well.
